	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes }
	effect = { var:ucm_target = { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = ucm_mn_maa_toughness_add } remove_character_modifier = ucm_mn_maa_toughness_add } else = { add_character_modifier = ucm_mp_maa_toughness_add } } }
}
